tasks.title: Project Setup and Configuration
tasks.description: Initialize the Next.js 15 project with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI components. Configure ESLint, Prettier, and set up the project structure.
tasks.details:
1. Create a new Next.js 15 project with App Router: `npx create-next-app@latest dietaibest --typescript --tailwind --eslint --app`
2. Install and configure Shadcn UI: `npx shadcn-ui@latest init`
3. Set up project structure with directories for components, hooks, utils, types, and API services
4. Configure TypeScript with strict mode in tsconfig.json
5. Set up ESLint and Prettier with recommended rules
6. Configure Tailwind CSS with custom theme tokens for the design system
7. Create a base layout with responsive breakpoints (mobile < 640px, tablet 641-1024px, desktop > 1024px)
8. Set up Git repository with appropriate .gitignore
9. Configure Vercel deployment settings
10. Install required dependencies: `npm install next-intl@3.0.0 react-query@5.0.0 framer-motion@11.0.0 zod@3.22.4`
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verify project builds without errors: `npm run build`
2. Ensure TypeScript type checking passes: `npm run typecheck`
3. Validate ESLint configuration: `npm run lint`
4. Test responsive layout rendering on different viewport sizes using Playwright
5. Verify Shadcn UI components render correctly

tasks.title: Authentication System Implementation
tasks.description: Implement authentication using Supabase Auth and next-auth with Google OAuth integration. Set up JWT handling with httpOnly cookies and silent refresh mechanism.
tasks.details:
1. Install required packages: `npm install @supabase/supabase-js@2.39.0 next-auth@4.24.5`
2. Create Supabase client utility in `lib/supabase.ts`
3. Configure next-auth with Supabase provider in `app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts`
4. Set up Google OAuth provider in Supabase dashboard and next-auth config
5. Implement JWT storage in httpOnly cookies
6. Create authentication context provider in `contexts/AuthContext.tsx`
7. Build sign-in and sign-up forms with email validation
8. Implement magic link authentication flow
9. Create `/auth/refresh` endpoint for silent JWT refresh
10. Add authentication middleware to protect routes
11. Implement sign-out functionality
12. Create AuthGuard component for protected routes
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit test authentication context with React Testing Library
2. Test sign-in form validation with various inputs
3. Mock Supabase responses to test successful and failed authentication
4. Test JWT refresh mechanism with expired tokens
5. Verify Google OAuth flow redirects correctly
6. Test protected routes redirect unauthenticated users
7. Verify sign-out clears cookies and session state

tasks.title: Multi-language Support
tasks.description: Implement internationalization (i18n) with next-intl to support English, Polish, and Spanish languages. Create language switcher and ensure all UI strings are translatable.
tasks.details:
1. Install next-intl: `npm install next-intl@3.0.0`
2. Configure next-intl in `next.config.js` with supported locales (EN, PL, ES)
3. Create locale files in `messages/{locale}.json` for each supported language
4. Set up language detection middleware in `middleware.ts`
5. Create a language switcher component in `components/LanguageSwitcher.tsx`
6. Implement locale persistence using cookies
7. Extract all UI strings into translation keys
8. Create a custom hook `useTranslation` for accessing translations
9. Implement locale-specific formatting for dates, numbers, and currencies
10. Add language preference to user profile in Supabase
11. Ensure all dynamic content (errors, notifications) uses translation keys
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test language switcher changes locale correctly
2. Verify translations load for each supported language
3. Test locale persistence across page refreshes
4. Verify date and number formatting follows locale conventions
5. Test language preference syncs with user profile
6. Verify all UI components display translated content
7. Test fallback behavior for missing translations

subtasks.title: Loading and Progress States

subtasks.details: Ensure smooth user experience with clear visual feedback.

subtasks.title: User Notifications
subtasks.description: Set up notification mechanisms to alert users of completion, errors, or important events during the meal plan workflow.
subtasks.details: Support both in-app and optional email/push notifications.

subtasks.title: Saving Meal Plans
subtasks.description: Enable users to save generated meal plans to their account for future reference or reuse.
subtasks.details: Implement backend storage and retrieval of saved plans.

subtasks.title: Tolerance Checking and Warnings
subtasks.description: Add logic to check if generated meal plans are within acceptable tolerance ranges for macros and calories, and warn users if not.
subtasks.details: Display warnings and suggest corrective actions if tolerances are exceeded.

tasks.title: Shopping List Generation
tasks.description: Create shopping list generation from meal plans with ingredient consolidation, quantity adjustment, and category organization.
tasks.details:
1. Build shopping list data model
2. Implement ingredient extraction from meal plans
3. Create ingredient consolidation algorithm
4. Build category-based organization
5. Implement quantity adjustment interface with debounce
6. Create real-time macro recalculation on quantity changes
7. Implement pantry management to exclude owned items
8. Build PDF export functionality
9. Create shopping list persistence in Supabase
10. Implement date-range selection for list generation
11. Add loading states and error handling
12. Create responsive design for shopping list view
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test ingredient extraction from various meal plans
2. Verify consolidation algorithm combines similar ingredients
3. Test quantity adjustment updates totals correctly
4. Verify category organization groups items properly
5. Test PDF export generates correct output
6. Verify shopping list persistence
7. Test date-range selection generates correct lists
8. Verify responsive layout on different devices

subtasks.title: Build Shopping List Data Model
subtasks.description: Design and implement a data model to represent shopping lists, including ingredients, quantities, categories, and metadata such as dates and pantry status.
subtasks.details: Define entities and relationships for ingredients, meal plans, categories, quantities, and user pantry items to support efficient data handling and future extensions.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit test data model integrity and CRUD operations; validate schema against sample meal plan inputs.

subtasks.title: Implement Ingredient Extraction from Meal Plans
subtasks.description: Develop functionality to parse meal plans and extract ingredient lists with initial quantities for shopping list generation.
subtasks.details: Create parsers or algorithms to identify and extract ingredients from structured or unstructured meal plan data, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test extraction accuracy with diverse meal plan samples; verify correct ingredient identification and quantity capture.

subtasks.title: Create Ingredient Consolidation Algorithm
subtasks.description: Develop an algorithm to consolidate duplicate ingredients from multiple meal plans, summing quantities and resolving unit differences.
subtasks.details: Implement logic to merge ingredients by name and category, convert units where necessary, and produce a unified list with adjusted quantities.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate consolidation with overlapping ingredient sets; test unit conversions and quantity summations.

subtasks.title: Build Category-Based Organization and Pantry Management
subtasks.description: Organize consolidated ingredients into categories and implement pantry management to exclude items already owned by the user.
subtasks.details: Assign ingredients to predefined categories for better shopping navigation and filter out pantry items to avoid redundant purchases.
subtasks.testStrategy: Check correct category assignments; verify pantry exclusion logic with sample pantry inventories.

subtasks.title: Implement Quantity Adjustment Interface with Real-Time Macro Recalculation
subtasks.description: Create a user interface allowing quantity adjustments with debounce to optimize performance and update nutritional macros in real time.
subtasks.details: Develop interactive UI components for quantity editing, implement debounce to limit update frequency, and recalculate macros dynamically as quantities change.
subtasks.testStrategy: Perform UI usability testing; verify debounce effectiveness; confirm accurate macro recalculations on quantity changes.

tasks.title: One-Click Shopping Automation
tasks.description: Implement Browser-Use agent integration for automated cart filling at preferred grocery stores. Create progress tracking and error handling for the shopping process.
tasks.details:
1. Create store preference selection interface
2. Build checkout request payload generator
3. Implement cart filling endpoint connection
4. Create polling mechanism (every 3s) for status updates
5. Build progress tracking UI with detailed status
6. Implement error handling for unavailable items
7. Create item substitution interface
8. Build cart completion handler that opens store URL
9. Implement partial success handling with skipped items list
10. Add loading states and cancel functionality
11. Create detailed logging for debugging
12. Implement retry mechanism for failed operations
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test checkout request with various shopping lists
2. Verify polling mechanism updates status correctly
3. Test error handling for unavailable items
4. Verify substitution interface allows item replacement
5. Test cart completion opens correct store URL
6. Verify partial success handling lists skipped items
7. Test cancel functionality aborts operation
8. Verify retry mechanism handles failed operations

subtasks.title: Design Store Preference UI
subtasks.description: Create a user interface for selecting and managing preferred stores for shopping automation.
subtasks.details: UI should allow users to add, remove, and prioritize stores. Preferences should be saved for use in automation flows.

subtasks.title: Implement Store Preference Data Handling
subtasks.description: Develop backend logic to store and retrieve user store preferences.
subtasks.details: Integrate with user profile storage and ensure preferences are accessible to automation modules.

subtasks.title: Integrate Cart Filling Mechanism
subtasks.description: Automate the process of adding selected products to the cart using browser agents or APIs.
subtasks.details: Support multiple stores and handle session management, product selection, and quantity updates.

subtasks.title: Develop Status Polling Service
subtasks.description: Implement a service to poll the status of cart filling and order processing.
subtasks.details: Regularly check for updates on cart state, product availability, and order progress.

subtasks.title: Build Progress Tracking UI
subtasks.description: Create a user interface to display real-time progress of the shopping automation process.
subtasks.details: Show stages such as cart filling, checkout, payment, and completion with visual indicators.

subtasks.title: Implement Error and Substitution Handling
subtasks.description: Develop logic to detect errors (e.g., out-of-stock, API failures) and handle product substitutions.
subtasks.details: Prompt users for substitution preferences or apply predefined rules for automatic substitutions.

subtasks.title: Create Completion Handler
subtasks.description: Develop a handler to finalize the automation process and notify the user upon successful completion.
subtasks.details: Trigger notifications, update order status, and provide a summary of the completed shopping session.

subtasks.title: Implement Loading and Cancel Mechanisms
subtasks.description: Add functionality to show loading states and allow users to cancel ongoing automation tasks.
subtasks.details: Ensure graceful cancellation and rollback of partial operations if needed.

subtasks.title: Develop Logging Infrastructure
subtasks.description: Set up comprehensive logging for all automation steps, errors, and user actions.
subtasks.details: Logs should be structured, searchable, and support troubleshooting and analytics.

subtasks.title: Implement Retry Mechanisms
subtasks.description: Add robust retry logic for transient failures during cart filling, status polling, and order submission.
subtasks.details: Define retry policies, backoff strategies, and escalation paths for persistent failures.

subtasks.title: Integrate All Components
subtasks.description: Combine UI, backend, and automation modules into a cohesive workflow.
subtasks.details: Ensure seamless data flow, error propagation, and user feedback across all modules.

subtasks.title: End-to-End Testing and Validation
subtasks.description: Test the entire shopping automation system for reliability, usability, and edge cases.
subtasks.details: Simulate various scenarios including store preference changes, cart errors, substitutions, and cancellations.

tasks.title: Settings and Profile Management
tasks.description: Create settings interface for profile editing, family member management, store preferences, and subscription billing through Stripe integration.
tasks.details:
1. Build settings page with tabbed interface
2. Implement profile editing form with validation
3. Create family member management interface
4. Build store preference configuration
5. Implement Stripe billing portal integration
6. Create subscription management interface
7. Implement real-time macro recalculation on profile changes
8. Build theme toggle with persistence
9. Create language preference management
10. Implement settings synchronization with Supabase
11. Add form validation and error handling
12. Create responsive design for settings interface
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test profile editing updates user data
2. Verify family member management adds/removes members
3. Test store preference configuration
4. Verify Stripe billing portal integration
5. Test theme toggle persists preference
6. Verify language preference changes application language
7. Test settings synchronization with Supabase
8. Verify form validation prevents invalid inputs

subtasks.title: Design and Implement Tabbed Settings Interface
subtasks.description: Create a responsive settings page with a tabbed interface to organize profile editing, family management, store preferences, and subscription management.
subtasks.details: The interface should be visually clear, mobile-friendly, and allow users to easily switch between different settings sections.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify tab navigation works on all devices and that each tab displays the correct content.

subtasks.title: Develop Profile and Family Member Management Forms with Validation
subtasks.description: Build forms for editing user profiles and managing family members, implementing robust client-side and server-side validation for all fields.
subtasks.details: Forms must validate input such as email, phone, and required fields, providing real-time feedback and clear error messages to users[2][3][4].
subtasks.testStrategy: Test form validation with valid and invalid inputs, ensuring errors are caught and displayed immediately.

subtasks.title: Implement Store Preferences, Theme, and Language Settings
subtasks.description: Create interfaces for configuring store preferences, toggling themes with persistence, and managing language preferences.
subtasks.details: Ensure user selections are saved and persist across sessions, and that changes are reflected immediately in the UI.
subtasks.testStrategy: Change preferences and verify persistence after reload; check UI updates in real time.

subtasks.title: Integrate Stripe Billing Portal and Subscription Management
subtasks.description: Integrate Stripe for subscription billing, providing users with access to the billing portal and subscription management features.
subtasks.details: Allow users to view, update, or cancel subscriptions securely through Stripe, and display current subscription status.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate subscription changes and verify updates in both the app and Stripe dashboard.

subtasks.title: Synchronize Settings with Supabase and Implement Real-Time Updates
subtasks.description: Ensure all settings changes are synchronized with Supabase, including real-time macro recalculation and error handling.
subtasks.details: Implement robust error handling for sync failures and ensure that profile changes trigger immediate macro recalculation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Change settings and verify data consistency in Supabase; test macro recalculation and error scenarios.

tasks.title: Offline Support and Service Worker
tasks.description: Implement service worker for offline read-only access to saved recipes and meal plans. Create IndexedDB storage and offline UI indicators.
tasks.details:
1. Create service worker registration in `app/layout.tsx`
2. Implement asset caching strategy
3. Build IndexedDB storage for recipes and meal plans
4. Create data synchronization between Supabase and IndexedDB
5. Implement offline detection
6. Build offline banner component
7. Create read-only mode for offline access
8. Implement queue for pending changes when offline
9. Build sync mechanism for when connection is restored
10. Add error handling for failed synchronization
11. Create offline-first data fetching strategy
12. Implement graceful degradation for unavailable features
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test service worker installation and activation
2. Verify asset caching works correctly
3. Test IndexedDB storage and retrieval
4. Verify offline detection shows banner
5. Test read-only mode disables editing
6. Verify sync mechanism processes pending changes
7. Test offline-first data fetching
8. Verify graceful degradation for unavailable features

subtasks.title: Service Worker Registration
subtasks.description: Implement code to register a service worker in the application, ensuring it is registered after the page loads and only in supported browsers.
subtasks.details: Add registration logic in the main JavaScript entry point. Handle registration success and failure with appropriate logging.

subtasks.title: Service Worker Installation and Activation
subtasks.description: Set up the service worker's install and activate event handlers to prepare for caching and lifecycle management.
subtasks.details: Implement event listeners for 'install' and 'activate' events in the service worker file.

subtasks.title: Asset and Data Caching
subtasks.description: Cache essential static assets and API responses during the service worker install phase for offline availability.
subtasks.details: Use the Cache Storage API to store HTML, CSS, JS, images, and initial data payloads.

subtasks.title: Offline-First Fetch Handling
subtasks.description: Intercept network requests in the service worker and serve cached responses when offline, falling back to the network when online.
subtasks.details: Implement fetch event handler to prioritize cache, then network, and update cache as needed.

subtasks.title: IndexedDB Storage Integration
subtasks.description: Set up IndexedDB for structured data storage to persist user-generated or dynamic data offline.
subtasks.details: Create and manage an IndexedDB database for storing application data that needs to be available offline.

subtasks.title: Offline Detection Logic
subtasks.description: Implement logic to detect when the application is offline or online using browser APIs.
subtasks.details: Use the Navigator API and listen for 'online' and 'offline' events to track connectivity status.

subtasks.title: UI Indicators for Offline Status
subtasks.description: Display clear UI indicators to inform users of their current connectivity status.
subtasks.details: Show banners, icons, or notifications when offline or reconnecting, and update them dynamically.

subtasks.title: Read-Only Mode Implementation
subtasks.description: Restrict certain actions and switch the UI to read-only mode when offline to prevent unsupported operations.
subtasks.details: Disable or hide features that require connectivity, and provide user feedback about limitations.

subtasks.title: Queueing User Actions Offline
subtasks.description: Queue user actions (such as form submissions or edits) performed while offline for later synchronization.
subtasks.details: Store queued actions in IndexedDB or local storage, ensuring they persist across reloads.

subtasks.title: Sync Logic for Reconnection
subtasks.description: Implement logic to process and synchronize queued actions with the server once connectivity is restored.
subtasks.details: Listen for 'online' events and attempt to replay queued actions, handling conflicts and errors.

subtasks.title: Error Handling and Recovery
subtasks.description: Add robust error handling for offline scenarios, failed syncs, and cache issues to ensure graceful recovery.
subtasks.details: Provide user feedback on errors, retry mechanisms, and fallback strategies for failed operations.

subtasks.title: Graceful Degradation
subtasks.description: Ensure the application remains usable with limited functionality if offline features or service workers are unsupported.
subtasks.details: Detect lack of support and provide alternative flows or messaging to maintain a baseline user experience.

tasks.title: Accessibility Implementation
tasks.description: Ensure WCAG 2.1 AA compliance with proper ARIA attributes, keyboard navigation, focus management, and screen reader support.
tasks.details:
1. Audit all components for accessibility issues
2. Implement proper ARIA attributes on interactive elements
3. Create focus management system
4. Build skip-to-main link
5. Implement keyboard navigation for all interactive components
6. Create high-contrast mode toggle
7. Build live regions for status updates
8. Implement proper heading hierarchy
9. Create accessible form labels and error messages
10. Build focus rings for keyboard navigation
11. Implement proper alt text for images
12. Create screen reader announcements for dynamic content
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Run Axe/Lighthouse accessibility audits
2. Test keyboard navigation through all interfaces
3. Verify screen reader announces content correctly
4. Test focus management system
5. Verify skip-to-main link works
6. Test high-contrast mode toggle
7. Verify live regions announce updates
8. Test form validation error announcements

subtasks.title: Conduct Accessibility Audit
subtasks.description: Perform a comprehensive audit of the application to identify existing accessibility barriers and prioritize remediation based on WCAG 2.1 AA standards.
subtasks.details: Use automated tools and manual testing, including assistive technology, to document issues related to navigation, labeling, contrast, and dynamic content.

subtasks.title: Implement ARIA Roles and Attributes
subtasks.description: Add appropriate ARIA roles, states, and properties to enhance semantic meaning and support assistive technologies.
subtasks.details: Ensure all interactive elements and dynamic regions are properly described for screen readers and other AT.

subtasks.title: Enhance Keyboard Navigation
subtasks.description: Ensure all interactive elements are accessible and operable via keyboard alone, with a logical tab order.
subtasks.details: Test navigation using only the keyboard and address any focus traps or inaccessible controls.

subtasks.title: Manage Focus States
subtasks.description: Implement and maintain visible focus indicators and logical focus management for all interactive elements.
subtasks.details: Ensure focus is programmatically set after dynamic updates and that users never lose track of their position.

subtasks.title: Add Skip Links
subtasks.description: Provide skip navigation links to allow users to bypass repetitive content and quickly access main sections.
subtasks.details: Ensure skip links are visible on focus and function correctly with keyboard navigation.

subtasks.title: Implement High-Contrast Mode Support
subtasks.description: Ensure the application supports high-contrast mode and meets minimum color contrast requirements.
subtasks.details: Test with system high-contrast settings and verify all content remains readable and usable.

subtasks.title: Configure Live Regions
subtasks.description: Use ARIA live regions to announce dynamic content changes to assistive technologies.
subtasks.details: Mark notifications, alerts, and other dynamic updates with appropriate ARIA live attributes.

subtasks.title: Establish Heading Hierarchy
subtasks.description: Structure content with a logical and semantic heading hierarchy for improved navigation by screen readers.
subtasks.details: Ensure headings are not skipped and reflect the document structure accurately.

subtasks.title: Label All Form Elements
subtasks.description: Ensure every form field has a clear, programmatically associated label for screen reader users.
subtasks.details: Use <label> elements or ARIA labeling techniques as appropriate.

subtasks.title: Ensure Visible Focus Rings
subtasks.description: Guarantee that focus rings are visible and meet contrast requirements for all interactive elements.
subtasks.details: Test across browsers and platforms to confirm consistent focus visibility.

subtasks.title: Provide Descriptive Alt Text
subtasks.description: Add meaningful alt text to all informative images and mark decorative images appropriately.
subtasks.details: Review all images and ensure alt attributes are present and contextually accurate.

subtasks.title: Implement Screen Reader Announcements
subtasks.description: Ensure important updates and changes are announced to screen reader users using ARIA and live regions.
subtasks.details: Test with multiple screen readers to verify announcements are timely and clear.

tasks.title: Performance Optimization and Analytics
tasks.description: Optimize application performance with code splitting, lazy loading, and implement Plausible analytics for tracking user journeys and conversion funnels.
tasks.details:
1. Implement code splitting for large components
2. Create lazy loading for non-critical components
3. Optimize image loading with next/image
4. Implement Plausible analytics
5. Create custom events for user journey tracking
6. Build conversion funnel tracking (plan→cart)
7. Implement performance monitoring
8. Create error boundary components
9. Build retry mechanisms for failed requests
10. Implement skeleton loaders for all data-dependent components
11. Create toast notification system
12. Optimize bundle size to keep main chunk ≤ 200 kB
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Measure bundle size with `next build`
2. Test code splitting reduces initial load size
3. Verify lazy loading defers non-critical components
4. Test Plausible events fire correctly
5. Verify error boundaries catch and display errors
6. Test retry mechanisms recover from failures
7. Verify skeleton loaders display during data fetching
8. Test toast notifications for various states

subtasks.title: Implement Code Splitting for Large Components
subtasks.description: Divide the application into smaller code chunks by applying code splitting to large and distinct components, prioritizing route-based splitting for maximum bundle size reduction.
subtasks.details: Identify large components and routes that can be split, use dynamic import() and React.lazy to load them only when needed, and ensure critical components remain in the main bundle for optimal user experience.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that code chunks are generated as expected, initial bundle size is reduced, and all split components load correctly during navigation.

subtasks.title: Create Lazy Loading for Non-Critical Components
subtasks.description: Defer the loading of non-essential or secondary components using lazy loading techniques to further optimize performance.
subtasks.details: Identify non-critical components (e.g., modals, secondary widgets) and implement React.lazy and Suspense to load them on demand, ensuring that essential UI remains unaffected.
subtasks.testStrategy: Check that non-critical components are not included in the initial bundle and load seamlessly when triggered by user interaction.

subtasks.title: Integrate Plausible Analytics for User Tracking
subtasks.description: Set up Plausible analytics to monitor user journeys and gather data on application usage and conversion funnels.
subtasks.details: Install and configure Plausible analytics, ensuring privacy compliance and accurate event tracking across the application.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate that analytics events are sent to Plausible, user journeys are tracked, and conversion funnel data is accurately recorded.

subtasks.title: Implement Custom Events for User Journey and Conversion Funnel Tracking
subtasks.description: Define and trigger custom analytics events to capture key user actions and transitions through the conversion funnel (e.g., plan selection to cart).
subtasks.details: Map out the user journey and conversion funnel steps, implement event triggers in the codebase, and ensure events are sent to Plausible for analysis.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate user flows and confirm that all custom events are logged correctly in Plausible analytics.

subtasks.title: Optimize Bundle Size and Monitor Performance
subtasks.description: Continuously monitor and optimize the application's bundle size, aiming to keep the main chunk ≤ 200 kB, and assess performance improvements from code splitting and lazy loading.
subtasks.details: Use build tools and performance monitoring solutions (e.g., Lighthouse, Webpack Bundle Analyzer) to track bundle size and loading metrics, making further adjustments as needed.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run performance audits before and after optimizations, verify main chunk size, and ensure no regressions in user experience.
